feedback:
This was a tricky latency-only incident with no errors. The main challenges:
1. No error spans meant traces_error_origin and traces_first_error_time returned nothing, so onset consensus fell back to a log-based onset at 512 which was misleading — the alert fired at 360.
2. correlate_signals on `ad` said latency didn't shift because the threshold was too coarse for a doubling from 2.5ms to 5.6ms (small absolute values).
3. metrics_compare_baseline with manually chosen windows correctly detected the shift. This was the key tool.
4. The investigate_parallel subagents all returned "not origin" because they anchored on the log-based onset at 512 rather than the alert time of 360. For latency-only incidents without errors, the onset consensus tool is unreliable.
5. investigate_change was very useful for disambiguating two same-service changes.
6. The overall tooling is optimized for error-based incidents; latency-only degradation requires more manual baseline comparison work.
